title: Java Examples
description: Copy-ready Java programs for common tasks: console output, loops and tables, classes, records and sealed types, collections, streams, strings, files and error handling. Compile with javac or run with java File.java.

examples.title: Java: Say hello
examples.description: The main method is where this program starts. System.out.println shows a value and starts a new line. Save each example as Main.java, one at a time.

examples.title: Temperature conversion table
examples.description: A for loop with a step of 10 and printf width specifiers that line up a Celsius to Fahrenheit table in neat columns.

examples.title: Bank account class
examples.description: A class with private state, a constructor, methods that enforce rules and a formatted toString, driven by a small main program in the same file.

examples.title: Sealed shapes with switch patterns
examples.description: A sealed interface with two records and a switch expression that deconstructs each record; the compiler checks that every shape is handled.

examples.title: Word frequency with a map
examples.description: Counts words with Map.merge in a TreeMap so the keys stay sorted, then prints the words that appear more than once.

examples.title: Grade statistics with streams
examples.description: Turns an int array into an IntStream to get min, max and average in one call, then counts passing grades with filter.

examples.title: Email template with a text block
examples.description: A multi-line text block with placeholders filled by formatted, which keeps the message readable in the source code.
examples.output:
Hello Ada,

Your order with 3 items has shipped.
Thank you for shopping with us!

examples.title: Write a file and count its lines
examples.description: Writes a small text file, streams it line by line inside try-with-resources, and reports non-empty lines, total lines and size in bytes.
examples.output:
4 non-empty lines
5 lines in total
61 bytes

examples.title: Palindrome check
examples.description: Normalises a string to lowercase letters and digits, reverses it with StringBuilder and compares the two.
examples.output:
racecar -> true
A man, a plan, a canal: Panama -> true
Java -> false

examples.title: Traffic light enum
examples.description: An enum with a field, a constructor and a next() method implemented with an exhaustive switch expression, cycling through its constants.
examples.output:
RED for 30s
GREEN for 25s
YELLOW for 5s
RED for 30s

examples.title: Parse numbers safely
examples.description: A helper that catches NumberFormatException, reports the bad input with the exception message and falls back to a default so the total can still be computed.
examples.output:
Ignoring 'x3': For input string: "x3"
Ignoring '': For input string: ""
Sum: 59

examples.title: Generic Pair class
examples.description: A class with two type parameters, accessor methods, a swap method that returns a Pair with the parameters reversed, and a toString.
